name: @bridge/d2c
description: D2C Module domain layer (imported from CV Naturals, ADR-237): schema, product-to-source mapping, formula costing, order lifecycle, invoice numbering, and the stock ledger. Backs the Orders, Inventory, Research and Notes sub-modules. No I/O, no framework — the host app owns persistence and the WhatsApp boundary, which is served by @bridge/whatsapp.
